guidebook.intro: Gamba omulimu gw’okola, obuuze abalala emirimu gyabwe, era oyogere ku musaala.

tips.title: “I am a farmer”
body: Mu Luganda ogamba **Ndi mulimi**. Mu Lungereza oteekamu **a** (oba **an** nga ekigambo kitandika ne a, e, i, o, u): **I am a farmer. She is an engineer.**
Emirimu mingi gikolebwa okuva ku kikolwa nga oyongerako **-er**: **farm → farmer**, **drive → driver**, **build → builder**. Naye **cook** asigala **cook**.

tips.title: Okubuuza omulimu
body: **What work do you do?** oba **What do you do?** Okuddamu: **I am a trader.** oba **I work in an office.**
**For** kitegeeza “ku lwa”: **I work for a big company.**

culture.title: “Gyebale ko” mu Lungereza
body: Olungereza terulina kigambo kimu ekitegeeza **Gyebale ko**. Abantu bagamba **Well done!** oba **Thank you for your hard work.**
